Send SMS.description: Sends one message to a single phone number.

Send Same Message To Many Recipients.description: Sends one message to a list of phone numbers (general send).

Send Personalised Messages.description: Sends a different message to each recipient, with your own message IDs for tracking.

Send Appointment Reminder.description: Sends a templated appointment reminder built from an incoming record.

Send SMS For Each Record.description: Loops over records and sends one SMS per item.
